supplemental_fixes.description: Resolve OAuth .env beside the executable before working-directory fallbacks so autostart and file-association launches use the installed client configuration; regression tests cover unrelated/missing working directories and existing overrides.

Publish ordered account health recovery after successful sync passes; retain full-reconcile failures across Inbox-only success; retry failed full reconciliation with independent capped backoff and make manual sync a full pass. Add double-BYE recovery and account-status regressions.
supplemental_fixes.validation_note: Double-BYE fixture counts actual SELECT failures rather than platform-dependent accepted TCP connections; recovery assertions verify subsequent SELECT completion.

supplemental_fixes.description: Rebase repairs onto upstream folder management/draft safeguards without losing guarded LIST delimiter/system metadata or local draft deletion accounting. Manual full-sync failures now schedule the same bounded retry as timed reconciliation; repeated failed IDLE cycles fall back to polling, and successful LOGIN no longer resets the IDLE failure streak. Add live loopback manual-retry/IDLE-fallback tests, hierarchy metadata and retry-schedule regressions.
supplemental_fixes.validation_note: Use compare_exchange_weak for portable atomic fault injection across Rust stable versions.

supplemental_fixes.description: Do not reset archive selection/detail when unchanged initial search debounce fires. Fake-clock regression fails against original source and passes after fix; real query changes still clear stale detail.
